column1: # clues.tsv for ft_boolean.h — hints only, never answers.
# (Multi-line output; this single member-less hint fires on any failure.)

This header defines a macro EVEN(n) plus a TRUE/FALSE type and message macros. Is a macro a function call, or text pasted in place? What does your EVEN(3 - 1) become once the preprocessor has pasted it in, and read by C's precedence rules, is that still the question you meant to ask? And are TRUE/FALSE and the two message macros named exactly as the contract names them?
